title: Framework Agreements for Purchase of White Maize (NON-GMO), White Sorghum and Rice
description: NFRA invites qualified AMCOS groups, large-scale farmers, and traders to apply for framework purchase agreements to supply white maize (non-GMO), white sorghum, and rice for the 2026/2027 procurement season starting 1 July 2026. Applications are submitted via the Digital Food Tracking System (DFTS) at dfts.nfra.go.tz.

documents.original_url: https://www.nfra.go.tz/uploads/text-editor/files/Mikataba ya Ununuzi wa Mahindi Meupe, Mtama Mweupe na Mpunga_1776341800.pdf

contact.name: National Food Reserve Agency
contact.address: P.O. Box 1050, Kizota Industrial Area, Dodoma, Tanzania

eligibility: AMCOS groups (registered certificate, TIN, valid grain business license); large-scale farmers (100+ acres, 200+ ton maize/rice or 50+ ton sorghum capacity); traders (2,000+ ton maize/rice or 50+ ton sorghum, valid tax clearance).
